title: Duplicating a coordinate after lifting
statement: Let $e:\mathrm{Fin}(r+1)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ be an embedding, let $F$ be a Gowers family of order $r+1$, and let $b\in\mathbb F_2$. Duplicating the lifted family at the coordinate $e(r)$ with value $b$ equals the lift along the embedding obtained by restricting $e$ to its first $r$ coordinates, applied to the family that appends $b$ to each input: $\operatorname{duplicate}_{e(r),b}(\operatorname{lift}_e F)=\operatorname{lift}_{e|_{\mathrm{Fin}(r)}}(s\mapsto F(s\mathbin{\|}b))$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a Gowers family of order $r+1$
